newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - March 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - March 13.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Arabia, Britain express deep concern over Middle East peace developments following Israel's decision to build new Jewish settlements.
- SABIC signs agreement to secure $850 million loan.
- Saudi Arabia needs 500 billion riyals to meet power needs in the next 25 years.
- Shaybah oilfield to start production in mid 1998.
- U.S. businessmen discuss joint cooperation in Saudi Arabia.
